details: Source review d7b560d3 adapters/opencode/control.rs: Current accepts any nonempty expected_turn then POSTs text/delivery=steer/metadata without expected-turn native precondition. domain/adapter.rs requires native enforcement. If active turnA completes andB starts before POST, input reachesB and response still validates success. Existing test passes arbitrary turn-current and asserts POST, so checks only nonempty string. Minimal fix until native exact-turn guard exists: reject Current beforePOST with descriptive unsupported reason, preserve Queue (V065LIVE proven Queue), regression no POST for observed Current. Owner OpenCode worker, Terra integration held for this delta; no native replay.
